notes:
Interim report, rewritten at the end of the run.

Dimension seam: createWorldGenerator(seed, dimension = DIMENSION.Overworld) dispatches to the untouched v1 body (createOverworldGenerator) or to createNetherGenerator, so every existing overworld caller keeps its behaviour and its golden hashes.

Nether terrain: netherrack bulk, lava sea at NETHER_GEN.lavaSeaLevel 31, four bedrock layers at the floor and under the roof with the outermost layer solid, and 3D noise caves against the frozen caveThreshold 0.42. The frozen threshold is untouched; a non frozen NETHER_NOISE.amplitude scales the normalised fbm3 output into the range where 0.42 is meaningful, because a three octave normalised fbm3 has a standard deviation near 0.13 and would otherwise never carve anything.

Goldens: the nether fixture lives in new top level keys (netherGenVersion, netherGenerator, netherEntries) instead of in entries, because world-a.terrain.test.ts regenerates every element of entries through the overworld generator. A regeneration is therefore additive: the last run produced 46 insertions and zero deletions, so the seven overworld hashes are byte identical.

Open items: merge the four L2 branches, wire decoration, villages and portals into the generators, regenerate the nether goldens once decoration lands, then re run every gate on a quiet runner.
